federal.source_name: MOHESR — Directorate of Studies, Planning and Follow-up
federal.note: Official minimum averages for morning study: the general channel (الحدود الدنيا للقبول المركزي — القناة العامة) plus the separate list for graduates of distinguished schools (المتميزين). Averages are the competitive average (total ÷ 7) and may exceed 100 because 8% of the foreign-language mark is added to the total.

rules.source_name: MOHESR — Private Higher Education admission guide 2026-2027

form.source_name: MOHESR statement on the central admission form (reported by 964 network, 9 Sep 2026)
form.note: Scientific stream fills 50 choices, literary at least 25; at least 10 must be institutes or polytechnic (technical) colleges. Distinguished-school graduates use the same general-channel form. Applied through the Qaddim app. Update from the official student guide each September.

krg.source_name: KRG Ministry of Higher Education — Zankoline
krg.note: Zankoline does not publish an official cut-off table; these are the lowest admitted composite scores reported by universities and student unions for the 2024-2025 intake.
